options.title: Targeted warning and transfer step-up
options.description: Warn the impacted segment in the exact language of the impersonation pattern, and step up verification on the transfer patterns the campaign uses. Scoped to the attack path, so most members feel nothing.
options.loss_effect: Bends the two-week curve from $148K to $55K

options.title: Blanket transfer hold above a threshold
options.description: Hold every outbound transfer over a threshold for manual review until the campaign passes. Contains fastest, but the friction lands on every member making a legitimate transfer, and a lean team has to clear the backlog.
options.loss_effect: Similar loss reduction, at a cost the membership feels

options.title: Close the coverage gap first
options.description: Bring the Howard University book into fraud-model scope before acting on the campaign. Removes the blind spot permanently, but the mapping work takes days the campaign does not give you.
options.loss_effect: No effect on the next two weeks

closing_note: These are not mutually exclusive. The recommended path pairs the targeted warning and the transfer step-up with closing the Howard University coverage gap — contain the campaign now, and remove the blind spot it is exploiting.
